about: Test files the shuffle census (scripts/ci-shuffle-census.mjs, #4405) found order-dependent and nobody has fixed at the cause yet. One entry per FILE: a file stays listed until the census finds it clean under every seed, because which cases of a file fail under a seed moves with its case count. `seam` names the group the fix belongs to (first-error evidence, not a root-cause analysis); `seed` and `test` are one example failing case, for the fixer, and the last segment of `test` must still appear in the file. The list only shrinks: delete an entry in the PR that fixes the file, and lower PINNED_FILES in tests/scripts/ci-shuffle-census.test.ts. Reproduce with `npx vitest run <file> --sequence.shuffle --sequence.seed=<seed>`. `byDesign` is the other direction (#4561 D1): a `describe` whose subject IS the order its cases run in opts out with `{ shuffle: false }` (never the whole file) and is registered here with the reason, so the exemption is visible and checked both ways instead of hiding in a test file.
